title: In the Auth0 Authorization Extension, request authentication handling can process claims from query… (CVE-2026-130236)
description: CVE-2026-130236 is a high-severity vulnerability in the Auth0 Authorization Extension where request authentication handling can process claims from query parameters without proper header validation. This flaw may allow an authenticated tenant user to access administrative endpoints improperly. Additionally, input handling during rule generation can enable modification of the tenant login rule published by the extension.
